subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Digital Minimalism
description: A micro-lesson that makes Digital Minimalism usable.

hook.text: The most powerful privacy tool isn't an app. It's choosing to share less in the first place.

buildup.text: Digital minimalism means being intentional about which platforms you use and what data you share.

discovery.text: Cal Newport's research shows that reducing social media use improves focus, wellbeing, and sense of control.

twist.text: Minimalism feels like sacrifice in a world where sharing is the default. But the default was designed to exploit you.

climax.text: You can't control what platforms do. But you can control how much of yourself you give them.

punchline.text: Share less. Keep more of yourself.

quiz.question: What is the core principle of digital minimalism?
options: Being intentional about which platforms you use and what you share
Deleting all technology from your life
Using every platform but with privacy settings enabled
